source: BS 6399-2:1997 standard method: site wind speed Vs = Vb Sa Sd Ss Sp (2.2.2), effective wind speed Ve = Vs Sb with the terrain and building factor Sb of Table 4 by the effective height and the distance from the sea (2.2.3), dynamic pressure qs = 0.613 Ve² (2.1.2.1), the overall load of the front and rear faces × 0.85 (2.1.3.6) with the external pressure coefficients of walls (Table 5)

country0.description: Country site at the coast (0 km from the sea)

country2.description: Country site 2 km from the sea

country10.description: Country site 10 km from the sea

country100.description: Country site 100 km or more from the sea

town2.description: Town site (town terrain at least 2 km upwind), 2 km from the sea

town10.description: Town site, 10 km from the sea

town100.description: Town site, 100 km or more from the sea

riskCoefficients.name: Standard design (annual probability of exceedance 0.02, Sp = 1.0)

sources.speedFactors.heightFactors: BS 6399-2:1997 Table 4: Sb (k2 of the method) by the effective height He (taken as the height, no displacement height: SAEngine practice, on the safe side) and the closest distance to the sea, country and town sites (linear between, the 2 m value below)
sources.speedFactors.riskCoefficients: BS 6399-2:1997 2.2.2.5: Sp = 1.0 for the standard annual probability 0.02 (k1 of the method)
sources.speedFactors.importance: BS 6399-2:1997 2.2.2.4: seasonal factor Ss = 1.0 (permanent buildings); k4 of the method
sources.speedFactors.areaAveraging: BS 6399-2:1997 2.1.3.4, Figure 4: size effect factor Ca; SAEngine takes 1.0 (conservative; override wind.speedFactors.areaAveraging with Ca of the building's diagonal)
sources.speedFactors.combination: BS 6399-2:1997 2.1.3.6: the overall horizontal load as 0.85 × (front + rear) for the lack of correlation (Kc of the method)
sources.directionality: BS 6399-2:1997 2.2.2.3, Table 3: direction factor Sd, taken 1.0 for every direction (the largest; override wind.directionality)
sources.topographic: BS 6399-2:1997 2.2.2.2: altitude factor Sa = 1 + 0.001 Δs (Δs the site altitude [m]) and the topographic increment of 2.2.2.2.2: enter Sa as the topographic factor in Project Settings > Wind (1.0: sea level, flat terrain)
sources.gust: BS 6399-2:1997 standard method: the gusts are in Sb (1.0); the dynamic augmentation factor Cr (1.4, Figure 3) is not applied (valid for Cr up to 0.25 with the 1 + Cr factor not covered)
sources.cpWindward: BS 6399-2:1997 Table 5: front face of a vertical wall, D/H <= 1 (+0.85; less for deeper buildings: SAEngine keeps 0.85, on the safe side)
sources.cpLeeward: BS 6399-2:1997 Table 5: rear face, D/H <= 1 (-0.5; -0.3 for D/H >= 4: SAEngine keeps -0.5, on the safe side)
